ATHERION Earth | Ember Trace

ATHERION Earth is a virtual team for NASA Space Apps 2026. We are tackling the MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots challenge by developing a web application to explore satellite fire detections, historical patterns and sensor differences, with transparent data sources and uncertainty.

We welcome collaborators in Python, GIS, remote sensing, Earth science, web development, statistics and data visualization.
